parts.title: Sleepover at Odette's
parts.text: Odette invited Rishi and Cleo to a **sleepover**. They built a blanket fort in the living room and shared a big bowl of popcorn. Cleo felt a little **nervous** because it was her first night away from home.

parts.title: Story Time
parts.text: Rishi turned off the lamp and held a flashlight under his chin. He told a silly, **spooky** story about a ghost who was afraid of the dark. He used a **creepy** voice, and all three friends giggled. On the wall, the **shadow** of Odette's teddy bear looked as big as a bear in the woods.

parts.title: The Midnight Sound
parts.text: At **midnight**, a floorboard gave a long **creak**. The sound made Cleo **startle**, but it was only Odette's dad bringing warm cocoa. “Let's play a **prank** on him tomorrow,” whispered Odette. Cleo had to **stifle** her giggles, and Rishi pulled a pillow over his face to **muffle** his laughter. Soft **moonlight** poured through the window and made the fort glow silver.

parts.title: Sweet Dreams
parts.text: Soon everyone was snug and sleepy. Cleo smiled in the dark, glad that she had come. Nothing had been scary at all, only silly and warm.
